summary: Re-review after the rework round: all five suggestions landed as worded and created no new problems. Sampan's 'in the open air' now matches Liam's 'actual sky' and the perfect outcome's 'real sky' (the tin-roofed shed is only the kitchen). Lighthouse Row still clearly has no outdoor seating without the cut clause: 'cellar', 'one long brick vault with no windows at all' and 'the only door opens onto a lane barely wide enough for a bike... you trade the harbour for lamplight', so the clue now works through experience, as a buried level should. Mina's 'whole trolley' matches Sampan's last-trolley review. Roxy's milk-buns, butter-tarts, milk-pudding and milky-tea line matches East Jetty review 3 point for point and stays playful. Maya's 'mission complete' keeps the trip_fund callback and no longer runs ahead of level_20's pinned send-off. Clues, voices, decoy evidence and outcomes are otherwise unchanged from the first review and still hold. This is a strong, fair penultimate level.
